messages.content:
Risk: Attack on AI agents' resources
Description: Attackers intentionally create vulnerabilities or exploit existing vulnerabilities in external resources (tools/database/applications/services/other agents) that AI agents rely on to execute their intended actions or to achieve their goals.
Concern: Compromised external resources could impact the AI agent's performance in different ways, such as manipulating AI agents to pursue a different goal, manipulating AI agents to execute undesired actions, capturing and relaying interactions between AI agents to malicious actors, and getting AI agents to share personal or confidential information.
Policy: Supply Chain & Geopolitical Risks

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/GoalsAndObjectives/Objectives/Aim: aim — intention specifying a desired direction, condition, or situation toward which an agent's actions are directed, without requiring precise scope or measurable criteria [found by 2/2 queries]
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 2/2 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001017: Agent — A Material Entity that bears an Agent Capability. [found by 2/2 queries]
  Siblings: portion of pathological body substance, Target, physical sign
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 2/2 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Cyberterrorism: Cyberterrorism — Use of digital attacks against critical infrastructure or information systems to create fear and disruption for political ends. [found by 2/2 queries]
  Siblings: International Terrorism, Domestic Terrorism
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001379: Agent Capability — A Realizable Entity that inheres in a Material Entity in virtue of that Material Entity's capacity to realize it in some Planned Act. [from restriction: BFO_0000196 on ont00001017]
  Siblings: Strength, Affordance, plan

axes.rationale: The risk explicitly mentions 'AI agents' as the entities being targeted, making 'software agent' a relevant axis to represent the affected party.
The risk describes attackers exploiting vulnerabilities or creating new ones. 'Harmful How-To' represents the means or instructions used in such attacks.
